Post-op taping, day by day — the small steps after rhinoplasty matter as much as the surgery itself. What would you ask before your nose surgery?

Music: NO LIMITS PHONK — https://www.youtube.com/@nolimits_phonk
gaga5456
 
2h
Usually the tape stays on for about a week after surgery, then Dr. Qin Hao checks the swelling and decides what comes next — it varies a little from nose to nose. As for cost, there's no one-size price since the bridge, tip, and what you'd like changed all shape the plan. Would you want a subtle refinement, or a more defined change?
